title: The horseshoe tarot spread
description: How the seven-card horseshoe tarot spread works: its positions from past to likely outcome, a worked example and tips for reading the arch.

scenes.headline: The horseshoe tarot spread
scenes.caption: The horseshoe tarot spread arranges seven cards in an arch. It looks at the past, the present, hidden influences, you, others, advice and a likely direction.
scenes.vo: The horseshoe tarot spread arranges seven cards in an arch. It looks at the past, the present, hidden influences, you, others, advice and a likely direction.

scenes.headline: The seven positions
scenes.caption: Cards are laid from left to right along the arch, so the first card sits at the lower left and the seventh at the lower right.
scenes.vo: The seven positions. Cards are laid from left to right along the arch, so the first card sits at the lower left and the seventh at the lower right.

scenes.headline: How the arch reads
scenes.caption: The shape helps with interpretation. The first two cards set the scene.
scenes.vo: How the arch reads. The shape helps with interpretation. The first two cards set the scene.
